change: The spectral operability method, illustrative calculation and limits of use are presented for initial assessment.
The shared workflow test source digest is refreshed after unrelated test changes to restore exact report rebuilds; calculation inputs and results are unchanged.
Provenance now records the dedicated rebuild test and independent calculation fixture instead of unrelated workflow assertions; a manifest binds the delivered files to their exact bytes.

Sea-state result values in the calculation record are stored to 13 significant digits so the delivered bytes do not depend on last-bit floating-point differences between processors; displayed values are unchanged.

Complete ordered output, finite scalar values and screening arithmetic are checked against independent input snapshots before reporting; returned summaries are copied to preserve the comparison basis.
Occurrence weights are divided before conversion to percent so valid threshold equality is retained; independent literal and spectral boundary controls cover the correction.

Occurrence weights are accumulated in input order to preserve the spectral engine's threshold disposition across Python versions; literal and spectral four-state controls retain authentic failed screening.
